title: Vulkan transparent window stopped working on Windows 11
body:
### Tested versions

v4.5.stable.official [876b29033], v4.5 rc1

### System information

Godot v4.5.stable - Windows 11 (build 26100) - Multi-window, 2 monitors - Vulkan (Forward+) - dedicated NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3060 Laptop GPU (NVIDIA; 32.0.15.8142) - AMD Ryzen 5 5600H with Radeon Graphics (12 threads) - 13.85 GiB memory

### Issue description

I've been creating an overlay application for several months now with transparent maximized window and clickthrough functionality but suddenly it stopped working, the background is completely black and opaque now, I assume it happened after the last Windows 11 auto update

I've managed to make it transparent again by switching rendering device to d3d12 in project settings, but seems like now I can't add WS_EX_TRANSPARENT flag to the window to make it clickthrough when using d3d12, I used to toggle this flag when mouse is over transparent parts of viewport

### Steps to reproduce

Setup the following project settings:

[display]

window/size/mode=2       (Maximized)
window/size/borderless=true
window/size/always_on_top=true
window/size/transparent=true
window/per_pixel_transparency/allowed=true

[rendering]

viewport/transparent_background=true

=> this results with the black background

if switched to d3d12 the background is transparent

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

[godot-test.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/22864464/godot-test.zip)
